options.text: So the major scale pattern is followed

questions.question: What is the difference between a scale and a key?

options.text: A scale shows the notes in a fixed order. A key is about which notes the music is built on and which note is the center.
A scale has a key signature, a key does not
There is no difference - the words mean the same thing

options.text: Yes, they can share the same notes but have different tonics
No, every key contains different notes
